title: Part in strict side or back view
description: A strict orthographic side (exactly 90 degrees) or back (exactly 180) view of a part or the body, the A-pose held. Gated by the user: it multiplies the render count.

body.subject: Reference the attached strict-front sheet and the accepted front render of the {{subject_part}}. Render the same {{subject_part}} as a strict orthographic {{angle}} view.
body.action: {{angle_rule}} The part and the A-pose are held exactly as in the front view.
body.camera: Strict orthographic, no three-quarter, no perspective, same scale and ground line as the front view.
body.style: White background, neutral flat lighting; same materials and wear; sharp focus at 2K.
body.constraints: The render count is proposed to the user before any multi-view is generated.

angle_rule.default: Side view is exactly a 90 degree profile; back view is exactly 180 degrees, dead-back.

negatives: no environment, shadow or rim lighting

provenance.note: MIT (Copyright (c) 2026 Mr. Mak Workspace contributors); the wording is adapted to Lampway's five-part body and its five-negative cap (the upstream negative list is shipped as the long-negative variant where it is a tuning question)

design_plate.description: the accepted front render of the part

gates.description: propose the render count and wait for the user's answer

openai/gpt-image*.note: GPT Image wants the reference order stated in prose and takes an explicit size (<= 3840 per edge, ~8.3 MP)

black-forest-labs/*.note: takes resolution + aspect_ratio; tolerates shorter prompts

google/gemini*.note: takes resolution + aspect_ratio; tolerates shorter prompts

sourceful/*.note: Riverflow: flattest albedo; takes resolution + aspect_ratio
